kaikki_vikisozluk.e: حَبَّذَا • (ḥabbaḏā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Univerbation of حَبَّ (ḥabba, “to like”) + ذَا (ḏā, “this”).
g: how good is...! how lovely is...!

kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
حبذا (form II)
# حَبَّذَا (ḥabbaḏā) /ħab.ba.ðaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of حَبَّذَ (ḥabbaḏa)
# حُبِّذَا (ḥubbiḏā) /ħub.bi.ðaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of حَبَّذَ (ḥabbaḏa)
# حَبِّذَا (ḥabbiḏā) /ħab.bi.ðaː/: second-person dual imperative of حَبَّذَ (ḥabbaḏa)
حَبَّذَ • (ḥabbaḏa) II (non-past يُحَبِّذُ (yuḥabbiḏu), verbal noun تَحْبِيذ (taḥbīḏ))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Back-formation of the inconjugable verb or phrase حَبَّذَا (ḥabbaḏā, “the subject appreciates it, favourably, it would be preferred”), itself univerbation of حَبَّ (ḥabba, “to like”) + ذَا (ḏā, “this”).
g: to applaud, to condone, to utter favour of, to find lovely
